text:
elaine: Ticket #2492 — enterprise customer (acct-VERDI) reports rerank endpoint failing after they updated our SDK. They send a 422 and the body says: `error: deprecated_model, message: 'Model id "rerank-alpha" is deprecated'`. Customer insists they never set that id, app just started failing.

elaine: Their minimal repro call (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"rerank-alpha","query":"top how-to articles","documents":["a","b","c"]}
```

jon: quick guess — "rerank-alpha" was an internal preview id we deprecated in 2025-09 and replaced with "reranker-stable-2025". Could be the SDK default mapping flipped to the preview id in 1.2.0. What SDK version did they move from -> to?

elaine: They upgraded from redwood-js 1.1.7 -> 1.2.0 per their support logs. They say 1.1.7 was fine.

oscar: I pulled the request logs. The request hits router and gets rejected at model-type validation. Router log: 
```
[2026-03-12T09:10:02Z] req=abc987 acct=acct-VERDI path=/v1/rerank model_id=rerank-alpha -> 422 deprecated_model (model retired)
```

oscar: The model_catalog entry for `rerank-alpha` was removed but we left a deprecation marker. The rerank endpoint refuses to accept any id not marked as type=r-eranker in model_catalog. Previously we tolerated some preview ids via aliasing. That alias was removed in PR #3712.

jon: So two separate problems: (A) SDK change that selects the old preview id, (B) server strictness now rejects deprecated ids (intended) but we need better guidance.

elaine: Customer asked for immediate workaround because their pipeline is blocked. They want either (1) a temporary server-side redirect from `rerank-alpha` -> `reranker-stable-2025` or (2) a list of exact IDs to set.

oscar: I can add an alias to the model_alias map to redirect `rerank-alpha` -> `reranker-stable-2025`. Low-risk config change, but need to canary and audit impact. Also we should improve the error body to include suggestions and link to docs. Current error is terse.

infra-bot: config-change proposed: +1 model_aliases: rerank-alpha -> reranker-stable-2025. Triggering CI checks.

jon: Meanwhile, SDK team please add a safety guard: when SDK picks a model id for rerank API, warn if id is not type=reranker, and prefer stable replacement IDs. @sdk-bot any quick patch we can publish as 1.2.1?

sdk-bot: Created PR redwood-js#460. Patch adds console.warn when calling rerank with non-reranker model ids and suggests `reranker-stable-2025`. Planning semver patch release 1.2.1.

oscar: Patching alias in canary now. I'm also adding a better error message from the router: `{"error":"model_not_reranker","message":"Model 'rerank-alpha' is not a reranker (deprecated). Try 'reranker-stable-2025' or call /v1/embeddings for embedding models. See https://docs.redwood.ai/deprecations"}`

elaine: I sent the customer a temporary response: set explicit model to `reranker-stable-2025` or pin SDK to 1.1.7 if they need immediate rollback. They asked whether billing or quota changes will occur if they switch IDs. Answer: same billing for rerank calls, no quota differences.

oscar: Canary deploy done. I hit the repro payload and got success with alias in place: `{"scores":[0.91,0.45,0.12]}`.

infra-bot: canary report: no regressions, alias served 120 test requests, 0 model_not_reranker errors.

jon: Next steps (internal):
- Keep alias for 14 days and record usage metrics to identify who is relying on deprecated id.
- Add unit + integration test that validates deprecated ids either redirect or produce a helpful error before we remove them in the future.
- SDK: release 1.2.1 with warning and opt-in migration helper.
- Docs: add deprecation page for reranker preview ids and CLI script to bulk-migrate customer config.

elaine: Customer replied: temporary workaround works, they'll opt to pin to `reranker-stable-2025`. They asked for timeline to remove alias after migration. I told them 14 days notice and we'll proactively email any accounts using the deprecated id.

jon: Also add automated detection in the billing pipeline to flag sudden spikes of rerank calls coming from deprecated ids (so we can contact customers).

oscar: Follow-up: PR #3720 updated router messages and model_aliases; PR #3721 is SDK patch. Assigning to eng-runtime and devex to coordinate.

elaine: Closing loop with customer in case notes and will reopen if they see anything after prod rollout.

jon: Thanks. Small postmortem: cause = removal of backward-compatible alias + SDK default change in 1.2.0. Fix = short-lived alias + SDK warn + better error text + deploy tests.

oscar: I'll create a short KB item for support playbook: "rerank model mismatch / deprecated id" with repro steps and template responses.

elaine: Marking ticket waiting prod deploy.

infra-bot: prod rollout scheduled in 15m, estimated 4m.

oscar: Prod rollout finished, monitoring looks clean. Updating ticket and sending customer final confirmation.

elaine: Customer confirmed successful end-to-end flow and no further incidents. Closing ticket.
